value.description: An automated mount for a belt-fed general-purpose machine gun firing 7.62x51mm NATO. Long bursts make it a good all-round defense. Needs ammunition loaded. May explode when damaged.

An automated mount for a six-barrel rotary gun firing 7.62x51mm NATO. It spins up before firing and then unleashes a very long burst, at the cost of high power use and a lot of ammunition. May explode when damaged.
A manned mount for a .50 BMG heavy machine gun. Needs a colonist at the gun and ammunition loaded, but has long range and heavy rounds, and needs no power. May explode when damaged.
A manned mount for a 40x53mm automatic grenade launcher. Needs a colonist at the gun and grenades loaded, and cannot hit close targets. Needs advanced materials to build. May explode when damaged.

An automated mount for a 30 mm chain-driven cannon. Slow to aim and to turn, but its heavy shells hit hard at long range, making it the backbone against armored targets. Costs advanced materials and a lot of power, and needs ammunition loaded. May explode when damaged.

An 81 mm light mortar built to be moved. It is light and quick to set up, so it can be packed up and carried by caravan to another map or reinstalled in minutes. More accurate than the heavy mortar but with a shorter reach. Needs a colonist at the gun and mortar shells loaded.

A manned mount for a wire-guided anti-tank missile. One devastating shot at long range, but it cannot hit close targets and needs a long time to reload. Needs a colonist at the gun and missiles loaded. May explode when damaged.

An automated mount for a pod of unguided 80 mm rockets. Each salvo showers an area with explosions, best against groups. Cannot hit close targets. Needs power and rockets loaded. May explode when damaged.
An automated battery that lobs laser-guided 70 mm rockets in a high arc over walls at targets far away. It cannot hit close targets. Needs power and rockets loaded. May explode when damaged.

A manned twin mount for 40 mm Bofors L/60 automatic guns, the classic naval anti-aircraft weapon. The gunner sits between the guns and the mount traverses a full circle. Besides ground targets, it shoots down incoming artillery shells, missiles and drop pods. Needs no power, but needs 40 mm ammunition loaded. May explode when damaged.

A manned quadruple mount for 40 mm Bofors L/60 automatic guns, as fitted to battleships and cruisers. Twice the barrels of the twin mount for a much heavier volume of fire. Besides ground targets, it shoots down incoming artillery shells, missiles and drop pods. Needs no power, but needs 40 mm ammunition loaded. May explode when damaged.

An automated mount for a six-barrel 20 mm rotary cannon with a radar-driven, very fast traverse. It shoots down incoming artillery shells and missiles, and unloads an enormous burst on ground targets, at the cost of high power use and quick barrel heating. Needs ammunition loaded. May explode when damaged.

A light manned mount with two 23 mm autocannons, the classic cheap anti-aircraft gun. Very fast to traverse by hand. Besides ground targets, it shoots down incoming artillery shells, missiles and drop pods. Needs no power, but needs 23 mm ammunition loaded. May explode when damaged.

A powered turret with two pods of four Stinger heat-seeking missiles. It automatically shoots down hostile drop pods and other incoming craft; it cannot attack ground targets. Needs power and Stinger missiles loaded. May explode when damaged.

A powered close-in weapon system with a seven-barrel 30 mm rotary cannon and its own radars. It shoots down incoming artillery shells and missiles, and shreds ground targets, with a very fast traverse and enormous power draw. Needs 30 mm ammunition loaded. May explode when damaged.

A powered high-energy laser turret. It shoots down incoming artillery shells and missiles and burns ground targets at long range. Needs no ammunition at all, but draws a huge amount of power and must pause when its optics overheat. May explode when damaged.
